meta.notes: Manages how a moment appears until a plain objection arrives. A real privacy claim on negatives later stolen. Privacy never reads as guilt. She is right about the window.

rs_s1.line: Thirty writers, six orchestras, and a new electric transmitter. And tonight the hero meets the same villain he met last Thursday. I'd complain, but I am the villain's wife, and I've got the good scarf.

choices.label: I heard a sheet of tin.

rs_s2.line: That was thunder! Fifteen years of stagecraft, and she laughs harder when the effects man rattles a sheet of tin. My own mother. I could hear her from the studio, I swear to you, in Queens.

rs_c1.line: I put out a notice for a scene partner. What I received were three invitations to dinner and a trained pigeon. The pigeon knew its lines. It has also asked about billing.

rs_h1.line: We are ignoring the sack. From the top. "Let him who is without sin cast the first..." Good heavens, what have you brought in that pillowcase?

choices.label: Say nothing, and look in the sack.

rs_h2.speaker: GUESTS
rs_h2.line: Custards. — Four of them. — We were told there was to be a stoning. — We didn't like to come with nothing.

rs_d1.line: I had prepared myself for a life of extravagant romance. Nobody mentioned the need for clean sheets, punctuality, or not eating the entire pie first. You may close the door. From the outside.

rs_p1.line: "Sat." I asked for a portrait, not an engagement. She got me between one face and the next, and put that in a window on Jackson Avenue. My name on the card. I've spent twenty years deciding what's seen of me, and a woman with a rubber bulb takes it in a fiftieth of a second.

choices.label: What did you ask her for?

rs_p1s.line: You're doing that very well. Most people fill that gap with their opinion of my eyes.

rs_p2.line: Of course it's a good picture! That's what's wrong with it! And you said that exactly how she did.

choices.label: What did you ask her for?

rs_p2s.line: Now you've gone red. Why have you gone red?

rs_p3.line: Destroy them. She took it down. She said it wouldn't go in that window or anyone else's, and she kept the plates anyway, and she told me it was the most reasonable she got. I went round on the twenty-second to ask again. Do you know, somebody'd saved me the trouble?

rs_p4.line: At home, with the booth shut. I recorded a take for my own files at ten, which I shall not be playing you. Ask me who heard it. Nobody. That's what the booth is for. You may keep your suspicion. You may not keep putting me in the window.

rs_h1b.line: I joined in. A person may join in. Twenty years I've never come in on a chorus for nothing, and I do it with a drink in my hand, and it splits, and the Kells girl has a machine in her coat.

choices.label: Miss Voss says it's the best thing on the tape.

rs_h2b.line: Miss Voss would say so. She said it in April, about my face, with the same expression. Tell her the answer's the same and only the medium has changed.

rs_h3.line: Enormously. Put that in the window. I'll be there Saturday, in the same chair, and I'd like it understood that I can do both.

rs_u1.line: She stood on my mat and confessed. I've had that girl's confessions, they come small. She offered to play it to me. I was there when it happened. I don't need it twice.

rs_u2.line: No. Tell the drummer it was good. Adela Voss kept my plates till somebody robbed her of them, and I don't forgive the plates. But she stood over that reel because I asked her to. Miss Kells may cut it. I shall come up and watch.

rs_o1.line: One. No. One. There's nothing to the Professor's trick, you know. It's breath. You bring a house down on the outgoing, and you never let it catch you doing it. One. I've done it forty ways this week, and in every one of them you can hear a woman saying "one" very well.
